summary: REQ-1 appears not satisfied: the frontend admin-role hook calls `actor.isCallerAdmin()` rather than the existing backend `isAdmin()` method, and the diff does not show navbar/link or route-guard changes. REQ-2 is only partially addressed: a video links manager/page is added/updated, but there is no evidence of admin dashboard navigation cards nor CRUD pages/flows for Pet Categories and Breeds. The diff also introduces unrequested “health topic” video management and includes unrelated feature work in the frontend summaries.

missing_requirements.requirement: Frontend admin role hook must call an existing backend method (backend exposes `isAdmin()`) and use it consistently so admins can access /admin and see the Admin navbar link; non-admins should not see link and should get access denied on /admin.
missing_requirements.reason: The modified hook calls `actor.isCallerAdmin()`, which conflicts with the BuildRequest statement that the backend method is `isAdmin()`. The diff summary does not show any navbar changes to conditionally render an “Admin” link, nor any /admin route-guard/access-denied screen implementation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admin Dashboard (/admin) must display navigation cards for managing Pet Categories, Breeds, and Video Links.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows changes to an Admin Videos page and a new AdminVideoLinksManager component, but does not show an /admin dashboard page with navigation cards.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admins can open the Pet Categories admin page and create/update/delete categories (including optional image upload where supported by existing UI).
missing_requirements.reason: No diff evidence of a Pet Categories admin page or CRUD hooks/components for categories.

missing_requirements.requirement: Admins can open the Breeds admin page and create/update/delete breeds (including optional image upload where supported by existing UI).
missing_requirements.reason: No diff evidence of a Breeds admin page or CRUD hooks/components for breeds.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin video links management includes a “health topic” category/tab and predefined health topics (Vaccination, Grooming, Nutrition, etc.).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-2 only asked for managing pet categories, breeds, and related YouTube video links; it did not request an additional health-topic video management section.

hallucinated_features.description: Large set of unrelated frontend features/content updates (AI assistant tabs/test harness, extensive breed/health catalogs, dashboard changes, etc.).
hallucinated_features.reason: These items are not part of the BuildRequest (which is limited to admin access fixes and admin content management surfacing).
